instructions: Before you declare the work done, run every command proof in this node's Definition of Done — `npm run check` and `npm run typecheck` — in the foreground and fix what they report. The controller runs them again at the gate and a failure there costs the whole attempt.

Never start a command in the background or through a task tool, and never wait on one with a sleep loop: the tool policy denies background Bash and the controller reads silence as a stall. Bound output with | tail -n 200.

Two hard constraints from the previous takes. (1) You are a headless session: ending your turn ends the session, nobody resumes you, and the controller treats a missing canonical result file as a protocol failure that discards the attempt. Never 'pause to wait' for anything. Run every command in the foreground with an explicit tool timeout (use the Bash tool's timeout parameter, up to 600000 ms) and keep each command under eight minutes: for runner.test.mjs use the three name-pattern splits `--test-name-pattern='^r'`, `'^a'` and `'^[^ar]'` (about four, four and six minutes alone), never the whole file in one command. If a command is killed by the tool timeout, split it further; never background it. (2) The controller rotates a Claude session after 600 observed turns and the rotation loses the worktree's uncommitted edits; take 1 died that way. Aim to finish well under 500 turns: batch related edits before testing, run whole files or pattern splits instead of many single-test runs, never re-read a range you already read, and run the full five-part suite at most twice.

The controller verifies this node with the full suite in five parts (runner.test.mjs split by test-name pattern ^r, ^a and ^[^ar] so each part fits the 600 s verification ceiling, then skills/mine/intent-factory/test/*.mjs, then test/*.mjs) and a failed verification discards the attempt, so run the same three commands yourself in the foreground before finishing, each with a generous tool timeout (they take several minutes; that is expected): `node --test skills/mine/intent-factory/scripts/runner.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -n 150`, then `node --test 'skills/mine/intent-factory/test/*.mjs' 2>&1 | tail -n 80`, then `node --test 'test/*.mjs' 2>&1 | tail -n 40`. While iterating, run single tests with `node --test --test-name-pattern='<name>' skills/mine/intent-factory/scripts/runner.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -n 60`.

Two root causes the orchestrator already confirmed. (1) `doctor checks repository prerequisites without mutating anything` and `doctor does not fail a driver resolved through an explicit executable` create a fixture repository with git init and no commit; the phase-1 runner requires at least one commit (git_head_required) and doctor now exits 1 there while the same doctor call is ok in a repository with a commit. Decision: doctor must report an unborn repository as a failing `git` check with a detail that says a commit is required, the two fixtures gain one commit (use `-c commit.gpgSign=false` like test/helpers.mjs does, the host signs commits by default), and a new named test proves the unborn case. (2) `resume adoption treats the canonical result file as primary evidence` rewrites <run-dir>/results/build.json, orphans the node and expects adoption to follow that file; after resume nodeState.result is null. Find out whether adoption now reads the attempt sidecar or the attempt worktree instead of the canonical run-directory file — that would be a runner defect to fix, because the canonical file is the documented primary evidence — or whether the orphan()/nodeState() helpers no longer match the worktree-era node snapshot; fix the real cause. Expect several of the listed failures to share these two causes and the worktree relocation of paths the fixtures inspect.

Third confirmed cause: `empty catch blocks in production scripts never increase` (test/ci-policy.test.mjs) counts `catch {}` blocks with an empty body across skills/mine/intent-factory production scripts against EMPTY_CATCH_CEILING = 32; the tree has 34 (runner.mjs 12, verification.mjs 6, supervisor.mjs 4, drivers/exec-jsonl.mjs 3, contract.mjs 2, and one each in campaign-autonomy.mjs, env-preflight.mjs, integrate.mjs, lib.mjs, notify/os-macos.mjs, outbox.mjs, tool-policy-hook.mjs). Phase 1 added them. Never raise the ceiling: give at least two of the phase-1 catches a real body (return or record the specific failure) or restructure them so the swallowed error is handled explicitly. The campaign-autonomy failure `public campaign CLI continues a detached controller after the launcher exits` timed out in waitFor (test/campaign-autonomy.test.mjs:155) under a loaded machine; reproduce it alone before deciding whether it is timing or a regression from the worktree changes to detached controller startup.

Triage every failing test by name before editing: classify it as a stale fixture (worktree paths, unborn repository, sidecar versus canonical file, maxParallel now accepted) or as a runner defect; fix fixtures by moving them onto the worktree model and defects in the runner; keep every assertion's intent. Do not add try/catch, optional chaining or default values whose only purpose is to make a null pass. Do not add `skip`, `todo` or `only`.

Keep your context small: read by offset or grep, never whole large files. scripts/runner.mjs is over 7700 lines and scripts/runner.test.mjs over 6500; grep for the test name to find its line, then read a bounded range.

Do not modify campaign control artifacts under .runs/control or .runs/campaigns and do not commit. Writing the canonical result file the controller designates is required, and tests may create isolated temporary directories.
decisions: A failing test is fixed at its root cause; assertions are never weakened, skipped or deleted, except a test whose behaviour the phase-1 spec explicitly removed, named with its reason.
doctor reports an unborn execution repository as a failing git check because an execution repository must have at least one commit.
The canonical run-directory result file stays the primary adoption evidence; the attempt-local sidecar is transport only.
nonGoals: Do not delete or redesign budget, progressPolicy, capsule, heartbeat, outbox, supervisor, campaign autonomy, dashboard or docs; later phases own those.
Do not change drivers, the worker result protocol or the contract schema.
